triplets.subject: Then Geodesic Distance
triplets.evidence_span:
Minimal Reproducible Model

In the first implementation stage, set

ℳ= ℝ𝑑,
𝑔= 𝐼,
∇= 𝑑,
𝐹∇= 0,
𝑐𝑠= 1

Then geodesic distance reduces to Euclidean distance, parallel transport is the identity, and covariant phase
coherence becomes the ordinary complex inner product.
